equivalents.reason: SpotDriver._opened and SpotDriver._robot are assigned together under one lock in open() and cleared together in close(), so `_robot is None` holds exactly when `not _opened` does: the second term of the guard is redundant and no caller can tell the two guards apart.

bosdyn-client's PowerClient adds the robot's lease wallet to a request that carries no lease, and LeaseClient.acquire puts the lease it acquired in that wallet, so the lease on the wire is the same one (advanced by one); the fake refuses any request whose lease is not the current one and refuses none either way.
